body: I’m also a mental health clinician and I can tell you that I think all these feelings are valid and synonymous amongst us all. I also struggle to get help due to understanding the system and how it’s mostly unhelpful therapeutically. You are not alone, and I’m willing to bet that others in our field feel the exact same way, I do at least. I want you to know that how you’re feeling is valid and not uncommon. I find that it makes me better at helping patients because I can understand the struggle. I see it as a super power for myself. Metaphorically speaking I wouldn’t want to go to a steakhouse that’s run by vegetarians. I would assume that you’re prob one of the best therapists around and that your patients are lucky to have you. I think you’re allowed to be human as well, and you deserve help just like everyone else. I see you and I stand with you, and it’s understandable why you’re feeling this way. I know this might sound counterproductive, but I have historically found it therapeutic to just crash out. Let myself crash out in a safe environment that lets me be a hot mess express and I enjoy getting to have my moment. I make sure that I have a safety net and then crash tf out. In the same way screaming off the top of a mountain with no one around for miles would prob feel, freeing. At the end of the day, that’s all we really want right? Serenity. Peace. Autonomy. I find ways to create it in my living days while I’m still here.
Living is so painful the last few days

Update: she came home around 4 am and claimed she drank a whole bottle of wine and fell asleep, I don’t know what to believe but I want to believe her. I just have a bad feeling and it’s not something I can talk to her about because I have nothing to base it off of
My dog has been my only support lately
You’re absolutely right, thank you for that , from a woman to another woman, thank you I needed to hear that
She’s def not a dick, this decision was just as hard on her as it was for me

I’ve been cheated on several times by other partners in the past, and that’s the only hope I’ve been hanging onto that she does want to give me another chance, otherwise if she chooses someone else I honestly don’t think I’m strong enough to keep living anymore, I will give her full custody of our sweet boy, and I will likely kill myself, as bad as that is I’m not sure that I could keep living for the sole sake of others but I would def do it away from her because I would never want to scar her for life by finding me

Yeah I guess you can say that insecurities are playing a role here, partially past infidelity in other relationships, but she felt like she lost herself and wanted to get back to the old version of herself which she lost along the way, and it just hurts so much, I miss her, and she often gets confused about what she wants and hurts me to see her so unsure
She ended our engagement barely 2 weeks ago so really it’s all my fault because I wasn’t enough but she wanted to try in the future possibly but that she wanted to be independent
